criticalGaps.finding: No quantum physics solvers (electronic band structures, Berry phase, topological insulators) exist in SECP. Claims regarding quantum topological physics are unsupported by code.
criticalGaps.remediation: Clarify marketing/reference boundaries: SECP is a continuum CAD/CAE/CFD platform, not an electronic structure or quantum solver.

criticalGaps.topic: Algebraic Topology vs CAD B-Rep Topology
criticalGaps.finding: SECP implements extensive B-Rep topology validation (Euler characteristic V - E + F = 2, manifold shells) and Gaussian curvature, but lacks persistent homology, Betti numbers, and algebraic topology complexes.
criticalGaps.remediation: Explicitly designate CAD topology validation as 'B-Rep Watertight Topology' to prevent confusion with algebraic/differential topology.

criticalGaps.finding: src/engine/structuralFem.ts uses 1D beam deflection formulas instead of true matrix assembly, while a true continuum FEM library already exists under src/engine/fem/core/.
criticalGaps.remediation: Re-route all legacy structuralFem.ts call sites to src/engine/fem/core/GlobalAssemblyEngine.ts.

criticalGaps.finding: Physical L-PBF build logs and CMM/CT inspection files are absent from the repository workspace, properly blocking V12 industrial qualification at SOFTWARE_VERIFIED_ONLY.
criticalGaps.remediation: Ingest empirical CMM point clouds and machine logs when physical test coupons are manufactured.
